meta.title: MetroPremium — Does living near the metro cost more?
meta.description: An open research project on Tehran apartment asking prices and walking access to metro entrances. Explore the evidence, uncertainty and methods in English or Persian.
language.label: Language
nav.label: Main sections
hero.title: A home near the metro.
hero.question: Does it cost more?
hero.intro: Distance to the metro is more than a line on a map. We bring together walking routes, property characteristics and neighborhood differences to examine the question with data.
hero.caution: Exploratory results are available. They do not establish a reliable metro premium: the estimates are uncertain, and historical network checks remain incomplete.

evidence.title: Before an answer, understand the data.
evidence.intro: The dataset card describes six months in 2024, but the file's observed dates differ. The audit found {{columns}} columns. We select the study period from the records and keep nominal prices from different years separate.

housing.title: What do these ads ask for?
housing.explanation: Price per m² is total apartment asking price divided by area. The project owner confirmed the total-price definition and toman denomination; this is not publisher verification. This summary also includes records without coordinates. It establishes neither current market prices nor a relationship with the metro.
housing.tails: Extreme values remain in the main summary. {{n}} records were flagged in the upper and lower 0.5% price tails; removing them is only a sensitivity check.

housing.iqrNote: The middle range spans the 25th to 75th percentiles of observed prices. It is not a confidence interval.
price.title: Where does the price definition come from?
price.explanation: These summaries use official source records. Interpreting the field as total price in toman relies on the project owner's confirmation. The initial audit recorded the absence of this definition in the publisher's documentation; that historical record is preserved.
price.audit: Initial source audit and observed field values ↗
map.title: A network we can account for.
map.intro: Metro tracks are never drawn by joining station dots. Route data have been acquired, but independent checks of geometry, station topology and historical operation remain incomplete. Public metro layers stay disabled until these checks pass.
map.alternative: Map text alternative: the small validation network contains {{nodes}} nodes and {{edges}} directed edges. It does not establish walking coverage across Tehran.

map.explanation: Street geometry comes from OpenStreetMap. This map shows a small network validation area; it does not display accessibility measurements for the housing ads.

mapped.title: From mapped entrances to an open question.
mapped.intro: Routing uses real {{month}} ads and the archived OSM snapshot of {{snapshot}}. Destinations are a retained subset of mapped entrances, not necessarily the nearest operating metro entrance.
mapped.warningTitle: The primary result is still unverified.
mapped.warning: Opening dates, entrance operation, map completeness and physical route access have not all been independently verified. Excluding uncertain entrances can overstate distances. This exploratory analysis does not measure a causal metro effect.
mapped.audit: Historical operation, track topology and entrance audit ↗
mapped.scope: Of {{valid}} price-valid records, {{candidates}} had usable coordinates and radii. Supported routes were computed for {{supported}} records. {{entrances}} entrances remained after explicit membership, station-name and network attachment checks.
mapped.chartTitle: Observed prices and distance to the retained entrance subset
mapped.aria: Exploratory distance summary for mapped entrances
mapped.privacy: Publication threshold: 30 records per group. Median differences do not hold property or neighborhood characteristics constant. The range below is the 25th–75th percentile, not a confidence interval.
mapped.table: View distance distributions and route quality
mapped.distance: Distance to the retained entrance subset
mapped.distances: Median network distance: {{distance}} m. Median network-to-straight-line ratio: {{ratio}}. Both use the same supported destination set, but their optimal destinations may differ.
mapped.modelScope: Common complete-case sample: {{n}} records across {{clusters}} neighborhoods. Percentages describe the model's association between log asking price per m² and one additional kilometer. They are neither observed price differences nor effects of building a station.
mapped.unestimated: Sample sufficiency or model identification requirements were not met.
mapped.clusterNote: Errors are clustered by neighborhood. Dependence between neighborhoods and unmeasured characteristics may remain. Technical outputs include price-tail, duplicate, location-radius, network-attachment and spatial-block sensitivity checks.
mapped.locationTitle: What if the home's position moves within its radius?
mapped.location: We sampled {{draws}} positions per origin uniformly by area within its disk. This is a scenario assumption, not the true distribution of location errors. {{failure}}% of scenario routes were unsupported.
mapped.change: Among successful draws for origins with an initial supported route, {{n}}% changed distance group.
neighborhood.title: Compare neighborhoods with care.
neighborhood.intro: Price and accessibility are only two aspects of a neighborhood. Descriptive comparisons require enough ads, a shared period and reliable locations. This is not home-buying advice.
neighborhood.quality: Start with a neighborhood's data quality
neighborhood.explanation: Only neighborhoods with at least 30 ads in the selected month are shown. Original English identifiers come from Divar and do not define verified geographic boundaries.
neighborhood.search: Search by neighborhood name or identifier
neighborhood.empty: No matching neighborhood has enough ads for publication.
neighborhood.coordinates: Valid coordinates within the study bounds
neighborhood.note: The project owner confirmed total asking price in toman. Coordinate coverage does not guarantee address precision. No ranking by price or metro access is provided.
neighborhood.emptyTitle: Every comparison starts with the data.
neighborhood.emptyNote: Choose a neighborhood to see its ad count, median price per m² and location coverage. The exploratory distance models do not establish an operational metro premium.
network.title: Distances are not all alike.
network.intro: The closest station on a map may not have the closest reachable entrance on foot. Accessibility depends on how streets connect and where people can actually walk.
lesson.title: Barriers change the distance.
lesson.explanation: Nodes are path junctions; edges are traversable connections. The shortest route has the lowest total edge length. A barrier can lengthen the walk even when the straight-line distance stays the same.
lesson.note: This is neither a map of Tehran nor a research finding. Edge lengths use hypothetical meters.
lesson.aria: Synthetic example: straight-line distance 290 meters; walking route {{distance}} meters
method.title: Trustworthy findings need a transparent process.
method.intro: This is an observational study. Adjusting for property and neighborhood characteristics does not make an association a causal effect of the metro.
method.measure: The analysis compares asking price per m² with straight-line distance and the shortest walking route to an eligible entrance. An assumed walking speed of 80 m/min is a conversion convention, not a live travel time.
method.models: The exploratory analysis fits three models: unadjusted, adjusted for property characteristics, and adjusted for neighborhood within one month. Confidence intervals account for neighborhood clustering. Historical operating-network validation remains incomplete.
method.radius: Location radii of 300 or 500 meters can change distance groups. Simulated locations are a sensitivity scenario, not an observed error distribution.
limitations.0: The project owner confirmed total prices in toman; publisher verification is not claimed.
limitations.1: An asking price is not a transaction price; an association is not a causal effect.
limitations.2: These are historical data, not a description of today’s market.
limitations.3: Extreme values remain in the main summary; sensitivity to excluding price tails is reported.
limitations.4: A location radius does not specify a probability distribution of position error.
limitations.5: Historical accessibility comparisons require verification of station opening dates.

about.title: Read the city through data.
about.description: MetroPremium is an independent, open-source project at the intersection of network science, urban analysis and geographic data. This educational research project is not a peer-reviewed paper and has no official affiliation with or endorsement from Divar, Tehran Metro, OpenStreetMap or a university.

gate.1.label: Listing data
gate.1.reason: The project owner confirmed total apartment asking prices in toman; price per m² has been computed.
gate.2.label: Network and geography
gate.2.reason: Historical streets and a subset of mapped entrances were audited and routed. Entrance completeness and historical operation remain unverified.
gate.3.label: Statistical validity
gate.3.reason: Exploratory models of distance to a mapped entrance subset have run. The primary operational metro access result remains unverified.
gate.4.label: Public release
gate.4.reason: Aggregate price and data-quality summaries, with explicitly scoped exploratory results; no listing locations or confirmed operational metro premium.
